content: Hamlet cigars are a well-known brand of cigars manufactured by Benson and Hedges. They are available in various forms, including miniature cigars and those of regular length. In their advertising campaigns, they are often referred to as the mild cigar. The brand was first introduced in the United Kingdom in 1964. More recently, Hamlet cigars have been launched in several Western European markets. In the UK, Hamlet cigars gained significant recognition for their humorous advertisements, which were directed by Paul de Freitas. These advertisements typically depicted an individual in an unfortunate or unfavorable situation who finds temporary relief from their troubles by lighting and smoking a Hamlet cigar. The ads were accompanied by the iconic tune of Bach's Air on a G String. However, following the implementation of bans on tobacco advertising in the UK and much of Europe, these advertisements are no longer broadcast.
